name: Cart Line Item
summary: Canonical target-controlled cart or order line composition with product identity, Price, optional Quantity Selector, and optional line actions.

anatomy.name: collection
anatomy.description: Native list and inline-size container for one or more line records.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native list item for one target-owned line identity.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Optional bounded product media, decorative when adjacent identity repeats its meaning.

anatomy.name: info
anatomy.description: Product identity, details, Price, Quantity Selector, and action wrapper.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required visible identity rendered as one link only when a truthful destination exists.

anatomy.name: details
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored selected variant, properties, selling-plan, fulfilment, or discount detail.

anatomy.name: quantity
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Quantity Selector composition region.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional wrapper for target-supported canonical Button requests.

anatomy.name: remove
anatomy.description: Optional target-controlled removal Button with product context in its accessible name.

anatomy.name: save
anatomy.description: Optional target-controlled save-for-later Button rendered only with a real persistence capability.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One semantic line composition; optional controls distinguish editable from read-only usage.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic layout that responds to the cart-lines container.

states.name: default
states.description: Readable target line with no component-owned mutation state.

states.name: linkedTitleHover
states.description: Pointer hover on the optional single product destination.

states.name: linkedTitleFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the optional product destination.

states.name: narrowContainer
states.description: Price and actions reflow from the actual parent content width rather than the viewport.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: One native list contains one list item per stable target line identity; the line is not a widget or article.

behavior.name: singleDestination
behavior.description: A truthful destination renders one title link; otherwise the same required identity renders as plain text and adjacent media is not a duplicate link.

behavior.name: priceComposition
behavior.description: Canonical Price owns current, compare-at, unit, labels, bidirectional isolation, formatting boundary, and passive semantics.

behavior.name: quantityComposition
behavior.description: Canonical Quantity Selector retains the sole native value and step behavior; the target persists changes and reconciles inventory, prices, totals, errors, and status.

behavior.name: targetActions
behavior.description: Optional canonical Buttons request removal or save-for-later; pending, success, error, rollback, persistence, focus placement, totals, and announcements remain target responsibilities.

behavior.name: controlledLine
behavior.description: The parent target owns line identity, content, constraints, mutation and persistence. Cart Line Item owns no store, formatter, hidden value, optimistic policy, network client, or live region.

properties.name: media
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the media element and collapse its grid track.
properties.description: Optional target-owned product media. Alternative text belongs to the rendered media and is empty when adjacent identity repeats its meaning.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty visible product or line identity.

properties.name: href
properties.unsetBehavior: Render the required title as plain text rather than an anchor.
properties.description: Optional truthful product destination used by the one title link.

properties.name: details
properties.description: Optional target-authored selected variant, properties, selling-plan, fulfilment, discount, or equivalent line detail.

properties.name: price
properties.description: Canonical Price composition containing complete target-formatted current, optional compare-at, and optional unit-price meaning.

properties.name: quantitySelector
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit editable quantity controls for a read-only or non-adjustable line.
properties.description: Canonical Quantity Selector composition with target-owned form name, value constraints, mutation and inventory policy.

properties.name: removeAction
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit removal when the target cannot truthfully remove the line.
properties.description: Canonical target-controlled Button request with line identity in its accessible name.

properties.name: saveAction
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit save-for-later when the target has no persistence capability.
properties.description: Canonical target-controlled Button request for a supported save-for-later service.

accessibility: Render populated line collections as a native ul with one li per target line identity; do not add article or widget semantics.
Keep at most one product destination and use decorative adjacent media when title or details repeat its meaning.
Compose canonical Price and Quantity Selector so their native semantics, labels, value ownership, constraints, and formatting boundaries remain intact.
Remove and save Buttons need product-context accessible names, visible focus, truthful disabled or busy state, and target-owned result feedback.
The surrounding cart or order target owns mutation announcements and logical focus placement after confirmed line removal.

web.notes: Canonical list/line CSS composes Button, Price, and Quantity Selector; a target controller owns line data and mutations.

shopify.notes: Liquid maps cart line keys, localized product detail and money, native update/removal form semantics, and optional Ajax/section refresh; runtime mutation evidence remains target-owned.
